Iris (PM): Quick scope + finance check. Two pilots expect guaranteed nightly embeddings in MVP; infra says we need reserved capacity. Need a billing model decision.
Ben (Eng): Technical tradeoffs: reserved GPUs solve latency/queue but cost is upfront. Pay-as-you-go risks throttling.
Sam (Finance): We can do two options: short-term committed booking (monthly) or a usage+peak surcharge for pilot orgs. Committed gives predictability.
Noor (CS): Pilots prefer committed if it guarantees SLA. They can sign a 1-month commitment.
Kai (Infra): Reservation required: 2 GPUs nightly 02:00-06:00 UTC. Lead time ~48h. We'll need an ops playbook for manual overrides.
Iris (PM): Pricing ask: what's the delta to pass to pilot vs absorb for strategic reasons?
Sam (Finance): Delta is roughly $12k/month for the reserved carve. We can offer a 20% pilot discount if they commit 1 month. Otherwise surcharge ~+40% on usage for peak window.
Ben (Eng): From product POV, I prefer to gate pilot batch behind an org flag and only enable after MOU signed. That limits exposure.
Noor (CS): I'll collect MOUs. Can we offer a lower commitment if we cap nightly tokens to 6M?
Kai (Infra): Yes, we can size reservation to 6M tokens/night and reduce to 1 GPU; infra ops effort drops.
Sam (Finance): Updated options: A) 1 GPU reserved @ 6M tokens/night, pilot discount 15% on that slot; B) full 2 GPU @8M tokens/night with 20% discount; C) no reservation, usage surcharge.
Iris (PM): Acceptance criteria for pilot carve: pilot signs MOU, infra provisioned, p50<=240ms, alerts on queue>50%, rollback plan to disable batch.
Ben (Eng): Implementation: org flag + routing + quota enforcement + fallback to small-batch model. ETA 3 days once MOU.
Kai (Infra): I'll provision for option A in 48h after MOU. Dashboard and alerts included.
Sam (Finance): I'll draft pricing clause and discount matrix; target to send LOI today.
Noor (CS): I'll brief pilots and push for quick sign. If no sign by EOD+3, we disable pilot bulk and notify.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feat/pilot-embed-billing-gate -> staging at 2930456800
Iris (PM): Decision: go option A (1 GPU @6M tokens/night) gated behind MOU. Owners: Ben (flag+routing), Kai (provision), Sam (pricing MOU), Noor (customer sig). Reopen if anything blocks.
